voice-input.description: Add voice-to-text alongside keyboard input in CapsuleInputBar. Works in both Main app and overlay Capsule. voice-recognizer-adapter.title: Recognizer interface + AndroidRecognizer impl
voice-recognizer-adapter.description: Define a JVM-clean Recognizer interface and the only file in the project that imports android.speech.*. Surface: interface Recognizer { start(languageTag, callbacks); stop(); cancel(); destroy() }, interface RecognizerCallbacks { onPartial(String); onFinal(String); onError(VoiceError) }, enum VoiceError { NoMatch, SpeechTimeout, Network, NetworkTimeout, LanguageUnavailable, InsufficientPermissions, Busy, ServiceDied, Unknown }, interface RecognizerFactory { isAvailable(): Boolean; create(): Recognizer? }. AndroidRecognizer wraps SpeechRecognizer, translates RecognitionListener Bundles + raw error ints into the pure callback shape. RecognizerFactory.isAvailable() is re-checkable so the controller can call it on every start() without importing android.speech.*.

voice-controller.title: VoiceInputController + state machine + JVM tests
voice-controller.description: Compose-scoped controller wrapping Recognizer. State machine: Idle / Listening / Stopping / Unavailable. Generation rule (Codex round 3): increment on cancel(), destroy(), AND after processing ANY terminal callback (natural Listening->Idle on onResults, Stopping->Idle, error->Idle). Do NOT increment on Listening->Stopping (the terminal callback we are waiting for must match the current generation). partialAtStop snapshot frozen on user-tap-stop; partials arriving during Stopping do not overwrite it. Error matrix per design (NO_MATCH/TIMEOUT user-stop commits partialAtStop; NETWORK/LANG/CLIENT toast+restore; INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS re-runs the gate; LANGUAGE_NOT_SUPPORTED disables mic for the session). Availability re-checked on start() via factory.isAvailable(); transitions to Unavailable on hard service errors. DisposableEffect calls destroy() + bumps generation + sets disposed flag.
acceptCriteria: VoiceInputController.kt exists and does NOT import android.speech.*
Public surface: state, lastPartial, partialAtStop, start(baseText), stop(), cancel()
JVM test partial-after-cancel: late onPartial dropped, inputText unchanged
JVM test natural-finish-then-late-callback: late onPartial dropped after Listening->Idle via onResults
JVM test stop-then-partial: partialAtStop frozen, late onPartial ignored
JVM test stop-then-NO_MATCH: commits partialAtStop
JVM test stop-then-final: final wins over partialAtStop
JVM test destroy-mid-listen: all subsequent callbacks dropped
JVM test double-start-while-stopping: second start is a no-op
JVM test availability-flipped-on-start: transitions to Unavailable
./gradlew test passes

voice-permission-gate.title: VoicePermissionGate + MainActivity cold-start route
voice-permission-gate.description: Permission gate mirrors RunCommandPermissionGate (Granted/Request/OpenAppSettings classifier + pending flag preventing rapid-tap stacking). MAIN_APP path uses rememberLauncherForActivityResult(RequestPermission()). Overlay path calls new AgentService.requestVoicePermissionViaMainActivity() helper that fires the existing bringMainAppToFront pattern with an INTERNAL extra EXTRA_REQUEST_VOICE_PERMISSION — no exported intent action. MainActivity adds consumeVoicePermissionRequestIfPresent(intent) called from BOTH onCreate AND onNewIntent (Codex round 2: cold-start does not hit onNewIntent). The helper sets pendingVoicePermissionRequest flag; a LaunchedEffect(launcherReady, pendingVoicePermissionRequest) in the Compose tree fires the launcher once both are true, bridging the cold-start launcher-not-yet-registered race. Voice extra does NOT flow through handleIntent / MainActivityIntentPayloadApplier.

AgentService.requestVoicePermissionViaMainActivity() exists and uses an internal extra (not an exported action)

voice-ui.title: Wire mic leadingIcon into CapsuleInputBar
voice-ui.description: Add a mic leadingIcon driven by VoiceInputController.state. Unavailable -> icon hidden entirely. Idle -> mic icon, tap routes through VoicePermissionGate. Listening -> animated stop icon, placeholder changes to "Listening...". Stopping -> stop icon disabled. onValueChange detects user-typed deltas during Listening (delta != joinWithSpace(baseText, lastPartial)) and calls controller.cancel(), preserving the user-visible text (NO revert to baseText). Send-button guard: canSend additionally requires voiceState !in {Listening, Stopping}; AND submit() itself gates on the same condition because KeyboardActions(onSend = { submit() }) at CapsuleInputBar.kt:188 bypasses FilledIconButton.enabled when the user hits the IME Send key (Codex round 3).
acceptCriteria: CapsuleInputBar renders mic leadingIcon when state is Idle and inputEnabled
Mic is hidden (not just disabled) when state is Unavailable
Tapping mic in MAIN_APP context triggers the permission launcher when not granted
Tapping mic in overlay context routes through AgentService when not granted
Partials stream into inputText with joinWithSpace(baseText, partial) — no leading or doubled spaces
Typing during Listening cancels recognition and preserves the current visible text

submit() itself is gated on canSend so IME Send key cannot bypass the button
